4:1: O people! Beware of your Rabb, Who created you from a single soul, created from it its mate, and scattered from both of them many men and women. And beware of Allah, in Whose name you ask of one another, and the ties of kinship. Surely Allah is a watcher over you.
4:2: Give the orphans their wealth. Do not exchange the good with the bad. Do not consume their wealth by adding it to your own wealth. For indeed, that is a great sin.
4:3: And if you fear that you will not be able to act justly concerning the orphans, then marry women who seem good to you, by twos, threes, and fours. If you fear that you will not be able to act justly, then one, or those whom your right hands possess. This is closer to you not committing injustice.
4:4: Give women their bridal-dues generously; if they remit anything of it to you with good pleasure of heart, consume it with good health.
4:5: And do not give your wealth to the foolish, which Allah has made a means of subsistence for you; and provide for them from it and clothe them and speak to them good words.
4:6: Test the orphans until they reach the age of marriage; if you perceive maturity in them, hand over their wealth to them. And do not consume it by being wasteful and hurrying because they will grow up. Whoever is rich, let him be abstinent, and whoever is poor, let him consume in an appropriate manner. When you hand over their wealth to them, call witnesses against them. And Allah is sufficient as a reckoner.
4:7: For men there is a share from what parents and close relatives have left, and for women there is a share from what parents and close relatives have left, whether it be little or much—a determined share.
4:8: When relatives, orphans, and the needy are present during the division, give to them from it as provision, and speak to them good words.
4:9: And let those fear Allah who, if they were to leave weak offspring behind them, would be afraid for them, and let them speak right words.
4:10: Surely those who consume the wealth of orphans unjustly only eat fire into their bellies, and soon they will enter a blazing fire.
4:11: Allah enjoins upon you concerning your children: For the male is the like of the share of two females. If they (women) are more than two, then for them is two-thirds of what he left. If she is one, then for her is half. For parents, to each one of them is one-sixth of what he left, if he has a child. If he does not have a child and his parents are his heirs, then for his mother is one-third. If he has siblings, then for his mother is one-sixth. (This distribution) is after the bequest he made or debt. Your fathers and your sons: you do not know which of them is nearer to you in benefit. (This is) an obligation from Allah. Surely Allah is Alim, Hakim.
4:12: And half of what your wives leave is yours, if they have no child; if they have a child, one-fourth of what they leave is yours, after the bequest they made or debt. And for them is one-fourth of what you leave, if you have no child; if you have a child, one-eighth of what you leave is theirs, after the bequest you made or debt. And if a man or a woman leaves an inheritance as kalalah and he has a brother or a sister, for each one of them is one-sixth; if they are more than that, they are partners in one-third, after the bequest made or debt, without causing harm. A bequest from Allah. Allah is Knowing, Halim.
4:13: These are the limits of Allah, and whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger, He will admit him into Gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein forever, and that is the great salvation.
4:14: And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger and transgresses His limits, He will admit him into the fire, he will abide therein forever, and for him is a humiliating punishment.
4:15: Bring four witnesses from among you against those of your women who commit immorality; if they testify, confine them in houses until death takes them or Allah makes a way for them.
4:16: And the two of you who commit it, punish them. If they repent and reform, turn away from them. Surely Allah is Ever-Accepting of repentance, Most Merciful.
4:17: Repentance with Allah is only for those who do evil in ignorance and then repent soon. Those—Allah accepts their repentance. Allah is Knowing, Wise.
4:18: There is no repentance for those who do evil deeds, until when death comes upon one of them, he says, 'I have now repented.' Nor for those who die as disbelievers. For those, We have prepared a painful punishment.
4:19: O you who believe! It is not lawful for you to inherit women against their will, and do not constrain them in order to take away a part of what you have given them, except if they commit clear indecency. And live with them in goodness. If you dislike them, it may be that you dislike a thing and Allah places much good in it.
4:20: And if you want to replace one wife with another wife and you have given one of them heaps of wealth, do not take anything from it.
4:21: And how could you take it, seeing that you had joined one with another and they had taken a firm covenant from you?
4:22: Do not marry the women whom your fathers married, except what has happened in the past. Surely that was an immorality and an abomination, and what an evil way it was.
4:23: Forbidden to you are your mothers, your daughters, your sisters, your paternal aunts, your maternal aunts, your brother's daughters, your sister's daughters, your mothers who nursed you, your foster-sisters, the mothers of your wives, your stepdaughters under your guardianship born of your wives with whom you have consummated marriage—if you have not consummated marriage with them, there is no sin upon you—and the wives of your sons who are from your loins, and that you bring together two sisters is also forbidden, except what has happened in the past; surely Allah is Ever-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
4:24: And married women among women are also forbidden, except the female captives whom your right hands possess; this is Allah's ordinance upon you. And those beyond these have been made lawful for you, seeking them with your wealth as chaste men, without committing fornication. In return for what you have enjoyed of them, give them their compensation as an obligation. There is no sin upon you in what you mutually agree upon after the obligation. Surely Allah is Knowing, Wise.
4:25: Whoever among you cannot afford to marry free believing women, let him marry from among your believing maidservants whom your right hands possess. Allah knows best your faith. You are from one another. Marry them with the permission of their families and give them their dues according to custom, being chaste, not committing adultery, and not taking secret lovers. Then if they commit an immorality after being married, upon them is half the punishment given to free women. This is for those among you who fear falling into sin. But that you have patience is better for you. Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
4:26: Allah wishes to explain to you, to show you the ways of those before you, and to accept your repentance. Allah is Knowing, Wise.
4:27: Allah wishes to accept your repentance, while those who follow their lusts wish that you would deviate with a great deviation.
4:28: Allah wishes to lighten for you, and man was created weak.
4:29: O you who believe, do not consume your wealth among yourselves by falsehood, unless it be a trade by mutual consent from you. And do not kill yourselves. Indeed, Allah is Merciful toward you.
4:30: Whoever does that out of hostility and injustice, We will cast him into Fire, and that is easy for Allah.
4:31: If you avoid the major sins you are forbidden, We will cover your evil deeds from you and admit you to a noble place.
4:32: Do not wish for the things by which Allah has favored some of you over others. For men is a share of what they have earned, and for women is a share of what they have earned. Ask Allah of His bounty. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of all things.
4:33: For everyone We have made heirs to what parents and relatives leave behind. And to those whom your oaths have bound, give them their share. Indeed, Allah is Witness over all things.
4:34: Men are managers over women because Allah has favored some of them over others and because they spend from their wealth. So righteous women are obedient, guarding the unseen with the protection of Allah. As for those women whose rebelliousness you fear, advise them, forsake them in beds, and strike them. If they obey you, then do not seek a way against them. Indeed, Allah is al-Aliyy, al-Kabir.
4:35: And if you fear a split between the two of them, send an arbiter from his family and an arbiter from her family. If (the two) desire to reconcile, Allah will bring harmony between them. Indeed, Allah is al-Alim, al-Khabir.
4:36: Serve Allah and associate nothing with Him. And do good to parents, to relatives, to orphans, to the poor, to the near neighbor, to the distant neighbor, to the companion at your side, to the traveler, and to those whom your right hands possess. Indeed, Allah does not love anyone who is arrogant and boastful.
4:37: Those who are stingy, command people to stinginess, and conceal what Allah has given them of His bounty. And We have prepared for the disbelievers a humiliating punishment.
4:38: And those who spend their wealth to show off to people, and believe neither in Allah nor in the Last Day. And whoever has Satan as a companion, what an evil companion he is!
4:39: What would happen to them if they had believed in Allah and the Last Day and spent from what Allah provided them as sustenance?
4:40: Indeed, Allah does not wrong by the weight of an atom, and if there is a good deed, He multiplies it twofold and gives from His presence a great reward.
4:41: How will it be when We bring a witness from every community and bring you as a witness over them?
4:42: On that Day, those who disbelieved and disobeyed the Messenger will wish that the earth were leveled with them, and they cannot conceal any word from Allah.
4:43: O you who believe, do not approach salah while you are intoxicated until you know what you are saying, nor while you are in a state of janabah - except when traveling - until you have washed. If you are ill or on a journey, or one of you comes from the toilet, or you have touched women and find no water, perform tayammum with clean earth, and wipe over your faces and your hands. Indeed, Allah is Pardoning, Forgiving.
4:44: Have you not seen those who were given a share of the Book? They buy error and wish that you would lose the way.
4:45: Allah knows your enemies better, and Allah is sufficient as a protector, and Allah is sufficient as a helper.
4:46: Among the Jews there are those who change the places of the words and say, 'We heard and disobeyed,' and 'Hear, may you not hear,' and, twisting their tongues and taunting the religion, 'Look after us.' If they had said, 'We heard and obeyed,' and 'Hear,' and 'Look at us,' it would have been better for them and more upright. But Allah has cursed them because of their disbelief, so very few of them believe.
4:47: O you who were given the Book, believe in what We sent down confirming what is with you, before We erase faces and turn them to their backs, or curse them as We cursed the people of the Sabbath. And the command of Allah is always carried out.
4:48: Indeed, Allah does not forgive that partners be associated with Him, but He forgives other than that for whom He wills. And whoever associates partners with Allah has fabricated a great sin.
4:49: Have you not seen those who claim purity for themselves? Rather, Allah purifies whom He wills, and they will not be wronged in the least.
4:50: Look how they fabricate a lie against Allah! This is sufficient as an open sin.
4:51: Have you not seen those who were given a share of the Book? They believe in idols and Satan, and say to those who disbelieve: 'These are on a more guided path than those who believe.'
4:52: Those are the ones whom Allah has cursed, and whomever Allah curses, you will never find for him a helper.
4:53: Or do they have a share of the kingdom? If so, they would not give the people even the speck of a date seed.
4:54: Or do they envy people for what Allah has given them of His bounty? But We gave the family of Abraham the Book and wisdom, and We gave them a great kingdom.
4:55: And among them are those who believed in it, and among them are those who turned away from it. Hell is sufficient as a blaze.
4:56: Indeed, those who disbelieve in Our verses We will soon cast into Fire; whenever their skins are cooked, We will replace them with other skins so that they may taste the punishment. Indeed, Allah is Exalted, Wise.
4:57: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, We will admit them into gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein forever; for them therein are pure spouses, and We will admit them into a dense shade.
4:58: Indeed, Allah commands you to deliver trusts to their owners and, when you judge between people, to judge with justice. What an excellent advice Allah gives you! Indeed, Allah is Hearing, Seeing.
4:59: O you who believe, obey Allah, obey the Messenger, and those who possess authority from among you as well. If you dispute in anything, refer it back to Allah and the Messenger, if you believe in Allah and the Last Day. This is better and more beautiful in result.
4:60: Did you not see those who claim that they believe in what was revealed to you and what was revealed before you? They wish to resort to the taghut, whereas they were commanded to deny it. Satan wants to lead them astray with a distant straying.
4:61: When it is said to them, 'Come to what Allah has revealed and to the Messenger,' you see the hypocrites turning away from you completely.
4:62: So how will it be when a disaster befalls them because of what their own hands have put forward, and then they come to you swearing by Allah, 'We desired only goodness and reconciliation'?
4:63: They are those in whose hearts Allah knows what is. So turn away from them, admonish them, and speak to them an eloquent word about their own souls.
4:64: We did not send any messenger except that he should be obeyed by Allah's permission. If only, when they wronged themselves, they had come to you and asked forgiveness of Allah, and the Messenger had asked forgiveness for them, they would surely have found Allah at-Tawwab and ar-Rahim.
4:65: No, by your Rabb, they do not believe until they make you arbitrator in that which they dispute among themselves, and then find within themselves no distress because of what you have judged, and submit with full submission.
4:66: If We had written for them, 'Kill yourselves' or 'Depart from your homelands,' they would not have done it, except a very few among them. And if they had done what they were admonished with, it would surely have been better for them and a stronger steadfastness.
4:67: And then We would have given them from Our presence a great reward.
4:68: And We would surely have guided them to a straight path.
4:69: Whoever obeys Allah and the Messenger, they are with those whom Allah has bestowed favor upon: the prophets, the truthful ones, the martyrs, and the righteous.
4:70: This bounty is from Allah, and Allah is sufficient as Knower.
4:71: O you who believe, take your precaution and mobilize in detachments or mobilize all together.
4:72: Indeed, among you there are such who linger behind. If a disaster befalls you, he says, 'Allah bestowed favor upon me, because I was not present as a witness with them.'
4:73: If a bounty from Allah befalls you, as if there had been no affection between you and him, he says, 'I wish I had been with them so that I might attain a great success.'
4:74: So let those who sell the worldly life in exchange for the Hereafter fight in the way of Allah. Whoever fights in the way of Allah and is killed or overcomes, We will give him a great reward.
4:75: What is the matter with you that you do not fight in the way of Allah and for the cause of the weak men, women, and children who say, 'Our Rabb, bring us out of this city whose people are oppressors, and appoint for us from Your presence a protector, and appoint for us from Your presence a helper'?
4:76: Those who believe fight in the way of Allah, and those who disbelieve fight in the way of taghut. So fight the allies of Satan. Indeed, the plot of Satan is weak.
4:77: Did you not see those to whom it was said, 'Restrain your hands, perform the salah, and give the zakat'? Whenever fighting was prescribed upon them, suddenly a group of them fear people as they fear Allah, or with an even fiercer fear, and said, 'Our Rabb, why did You prescribe fighting upon us? Would You not postpone us until a near term?' Say: 'The enjoyment of the world is little, and the Hereafter is better for him who guards against evil, and you will not be wronged by so much as a thread.'
4:78: Wherever you may be, death will overtake you, even if you are in fortified towers. If good befalls them, they say, 'This is from Allah's presence'; if evil befalls them, they say, 'This is from your presence.' Say: 'All is from Allah's presence.' What is the matter with this people that they almost do not understand a word?
4:79: Whatever good befalls you is from Allah, and whatever evil befalls you is from your own soul. We have sent you to people as a messenger, and Allah is sufficient as a witness.
4:80: Whoever obeys the messenger has truly obeyed Allah. And whoever turns away, We have not sent you over them as a keeper.
4:81: They say, 'Obedience.' Then when they go forth from your presence, a group of them plans by night other than what you say. Allah writes down what they plan by night. So turn away from them and place your trust in Allah. And Allah is sufficient as a Trustee.
4:82: Do they not contemplate the Quran? If it were from other than Allah's presence, they would surely have found in it many contradictions.
4:83: When there comes to them a matter of security or fear, they spread it. If they had referred it to the messenger and to those in authority among them, those among them who investigate and extract it would surely have known it. If it were not for Allah's favor and His mercy upon you, you would surely have followed Satan, except a very few of you.
4:84: Fight in the way of Allah; you are not held responsible except for your own soul, and encourage the believers; it may be that Allah will restrain the violence of those who disbelieve. Allah is stronger in might and more severe in punishing.
4:85: Whoever makes a good intercession, there is a share for him from it. And whoever makes an evil intercession, there is a share for him from it. Allah is the One who repays all things.
4:86: When you are greeted with a greeting, greet with one better than it or return it as it is. Indeed, Allah is the Reckoner of all things.
4:87: Allah, there is no deity except Him. He will surely gather you to the Day of Resurrection, in which there is no doubt. And who is more truthful than Allah in word?
4:88: What is the matter with you that you become two factions regarding the hypocrites? Whereas Allah has overturned them because of what they earned. Do you want to guide aright the one whom Allah has led astray? And whomever Allah leads astray, you will never find a way for him.
4:89: They wish that you would disbelieve just as they have disbelieved, so that you would be equal. So do not take friends from among them until they emigrate in the way of Allah. If they turn away, seize them and kill them wherever you find them. Do not take from among them a friend or a helper.
4:90: Except those who take refuge with a people between whom and you there is a treaty, or who come to you with their breasts constricted from fighting you or fighting their own people (they are excepted). If Allah had willed, He would have given them power over you, and they would have fought you. So if they stay away from you, do not fight you, and offer you peace, then Allah has not given you a way against them.
4:91: You will find others who desire to be secure from you and to be secure from their own people. Whenever they are turned back to fitnah, they plunge into it. So if they do not stay away from you, do not offer you peace, and do not restrain their hands, seize them and kill them wherever you find them. And those—We have made for you against them a clear authority.
4:92: It is not for a believer to kill a believer except by mistake. Whoever kills a believer by mistake, then the freeing of a believing slave and blood money handed over to his family is required, unless they give it as charity. If he is from a people hostile to you and he is a believer, then the freeing of a believing slave is required. And if he is from a people between whom and you there is a treaty, then blood money handed over to his family and the freeing of a believing slave is required. Whoever cannot find (one), then fasting for two consecutive months is required as a repentance from Allah. Allah is Knowing, Possessor of judgment and wisdom.
4:93: Whoever kills a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hell, in which he will abide eternally. Allah has become angry with him, has cursed him, and has prepared for him a great punishment.
4:94: O you who believe, when you go forth in the way of Allah, investigate thoroughly. And do not say to the one who offers you peace, seeking the transient gain of the worldly life, 'You are not a believer.' For with Allah are abundant spoils. You yourselves were like that before, then Allah bestowed favor upon you. Therefore, investigate thoroughly. Indeed, Allah is aware of what you do.
4:95: Not equal are those of the believers who sit (at home) without having suffered harm and those who strive (jihad) in the way of Allah with their wealth and their lives. Allah has favored those who strive with their wealth and their lives over those who sit in terms of degree. To all Allah has promised good. And Allah has favored those who strive over those who sit with a great reward.
4:96: Ranks from Him, forgiveness, and mercy; and Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
4:97: When the angels take the lives of those who wrong themselves, they say to them, 'In what condition were you?' They say, 'We were oppressed (rendered weak) on earth.' The angels say, 'Was not Allah's earth spacious so that you could emigrate therein?' As for those, their refuge is Hell. What an evil destination!
4:98: Except the oppressed (rendered weak) among the men, the women, and the children who are unable to endure any hardship and cannot find a way.
4:99: As for those, it may be that Allah will pardon them. Allah is Pardoning, Oft-Forgiving.
4:100: Whoever emigrates in the way of Allah will find on earth many a place of refuge and abundance. Whoever leaves his home emigrating to Allah and His Messenger, and then death overtakes him, his reward has truly fallen upon Allah. Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
4:101: When you journey on the earth, there is no sin upon you if you shorten the salah, if you fear that the disbelievers may inflict fitnah upon you. Indeed, the disbelievers are a manifest enemy to you.
4:102: When you are among them and lead the salah for them, let a group of them stand with you and let them take their weapons. When they have prostrated, let them be behind you. And let the other group that has not prayed come, pray with you, and take their precaution and their weapons. The disbelievers desire that you become heedless of your weapons and your baggage so they can launch a single assault upon you. There is no sin upon you if there is harm to you from rain or you are ill that you lay down your weapons. Take your precaution. Indeed, Allah has prepared for the disbelievers a humiliating punishment.
4:103: When you have completed the salah, remember Allah standing, sitting, and on your sides. When you are secure, perform the salah fully. Indeed, salah has been made a prescribed duty upon the believers at determined times.
4:104: Do not show weakness in pursuing that people. If you are suffering pain, they too are suffering pain just as you are suffering pain. And you hope from Allah that which they do not hope. Allah is Knowing, Possessor of judgment.
4:105: Indeed, We have sent down the Book to you in truth that you may judge between people by what Allah has shown you. Do not be an adversary for the treacherous.
4:106: And ask forgiveness of Allah; indeed, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
4:107: Do not dispute on behalf of those who betray themselves; indeed, Allah does not love one who is deeply treacherous, deeply sinful.
4:108: They hide from people, but they do not hide from Allah. Yet He is with them when they plot by night words that He is not pleased with. Allah is encompassing what they do.
4:109: Here you are, having disputed on their behalf in the life of this world; who will dispute with Allah on their behalf on the Day of Resurrection, or who will be a guardian (vakil) over them?
4:110: Whoever does evil or wrongs himself, then asks forgiveness of Allah, will find Allah Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
4:111: Whoever earns a sin, earns it only against his own self. Allah is Knowing, Possessor of judgment.
4:112: Whoever commits an error or a sin, then casts it upon an innocent person, has indeed burdened himself with slander and a manifest sin.
4:113: If it were not for the grace of Allah upon you and His mercy, a group of them had resolved to lead you astray, but they lead astray none but themselves and cannot harm you in anything; and Allah has sent down upon you the Book and wisdom and taught you what you did not know, and the grace of Allah upon you is very great.
4:114: There is no good in most of their secret talks, except for one who enjoins charity or a good deed or reconciliation between people. And whoever does that seeking the pleasure of Allah, We will grant him a great reward.
4:115: Whoever opposes the Messenger after the right path has become clear to him and follows other than the way of the believers, We will turn him to what he has turned to and cast him into Hell; what an evil destination!
4:116: Indeed, Allah does not forgive that partners be associated with Him, but He forgives other than that for whomever He wills. Whoever associates partners with Allah has indeed strayed into a distant error.
4:117: They call upon none besides Him except females, and they call upon none except a rebellious Satan.
4:118: Allah cursed him, and he said: 'I will surely take an appointed portion from Your servants.'
4:119: And he says: 'I will surely lead them astray, I will surely instill false desires in them, and I will command them so they will slit the ears of livestock, and I will command them so they will alter Allah's creation.'
4:120: Satan makes promises to them and causes them to fall into false desires, and Satan promises them nothing but deception.
4:121: Those—their shelter is Hell, and they cannot find a place of escape from it.
4:122: Those who believe and do righteous deeds, We will admit them into gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein forever; this is Allah's true promise.
4:123: It is neither by your false desires nor by the false desires of the People of the Book. Whoever does an evil deed will be recompensed for it, and he will not find for himself, besides Allah, any protector or helper.
4:124: Whoever does anything of righteous deeds, whether male or female, while being a believer—those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged in the least.
4:125: In terms of religion, who is better than one who submits his face to Allah and does good, and follows the religion of Abraham as a hanif?
4:126: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth belongs to Allah, and Allah encompasses all things.
4:127: They ask you for a ruling concerning women. Say: 'Allah gives you a ruling concerning them, and what is recited to you in the Book concerning orphan women to whom you do not give what is decreed for them and whom you wish to marry, and concerning weak children, and that you treat orphans with justice. And whatever good you do, surely Allah is All-Knowing of it.'
4:128: If a woman fears rebelliousness or turning away from her husband, there is no sin upon them in making a reconciliation between themselves. Reconciliation is better. Souls are prone to greed. And if you do good and guard yourselves, surely Allah is All-Aware of what you do.
4:129: You will never be able to maintain justice between wives, no matter how much you desire. So do not incline completely so that you leave her as if suspended. And if you make amends and guard yourselves, surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
4:130: If they separate, Allah will enrich each of them from His abundance, and Allah is All-Encompassing, Possessor of wisdom and judgment.
4:131: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth belongs to Allah. And certainly, We exhorted those who were given the Book before you, and you as well, to guard against Allah. If you disbelieve, surely whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth belongs to Allah. Allah is Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy.
4:132: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth belongs to Allah, and Allah is sufficient as a Trustee.
4:133: O people, if He wills, He can take you away and bring others. Allah is capable of this.
4:134: Whoever desires the reward of the world, let him know that the reward of the world and the Hereafter is with Allah, and Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
4:135: O you who believe, stand firmly for justice, witnesses for Allah, even if it be against your own selves, your parents, or your close relatives. Whether rich or poor, Allah is more worthy of both. So do not follow desires lest you deviate from justice. If you distort your speech or turn away, surely Allah is All-Aware of what you do.
4:136: O you who believe, believe in Allah, His Messenger, the Book He sent down upon His Messenger, and the Book He sent down before. Whoever disbelieves in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, and the Last Day has indeed strayed into far error.
4:137: Surely those who believe, then disbelieve, then believe, then disbelieve, and then increase in disbelief—Allah will not forgive them, nor will He guide them to a path.
4:138: Give glad tidings to the hypocrites that there is a painful punishment for them.
4:139: Those who take disbelievers as allies instead of believers: do they seek honor with them? Surely honor belongs entirely to Allah.
4:140: He has already sent down to you in the Book: When you hear Allah's verses being disbelieved in and ridiculed, do not sit with them until they engage in another conversation, otherwise you will be like them. Surely Allah will gather the hypocrites and disbelievers together in Hell.
4:141: Those who watch you: if there is a victory for you from Allah, they say, 'Were we not with you?' And if there is a share for the disbelievers, they say, 'Did we not gain advantage over you and protect you from the believers?' Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection. And Allah will never grant the disbelievers a way over the believers.
4:142: Surely the hypocrites try to deceive Allah, yet He deceives them. And when they stand up for salah, they stand up lazily, showing off to people, and they remember Allah very little.
4:143: They are wavering in between; belonging neither to these nor to those. And whomever Allah leads astray, you will never find for him a path.
4:144: O you who believe, do not take disbelievers as allies instead of believers. Do you wish to establish a clear evidence against yourselves for Allah?
4:145: Surely the hypocrites are in the lowest depth of the Fire, and you will never find a helper for them.
4:146: Except those who repent, reform, hold fast to Allah, and make their religion pure for Allah—those are with the believers, and Allah will give the believers a great reward.
4:147: What would Allah do with punishing you if you are grateful and believe? Allah is Appreciative and All-Knowing.
4:148: Allah does not like the open speaking of evil words, except by one who has been wronged; and Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
4:149: If you reveal a good or conceal it, or pardon an evil, surely Allah is All-Pardoning, All-Powerful.
4:150: Surely those who disbelieve in Allah and His messengers, desire to separate between Allah and His messengers, and say, 'We believe in some and disbelieve in some,' and wish to adopt a way in between,
4:151: Those are truly the disbelievers, and We have prepared a humiliating punishment for the disbelievers.
4:152: And those who believe in Allah and His messengers and do not differentiate between any of them, to those He will soon give their rewards. Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
4:153: The People of the Book ask you to bring down a book to them from heaven. Indeed, they had asked Moses for something greater than this and said, 'Show us Allah openly.' Thereupon the thunderbolt struck them because of their wrongdoing. Then, after clear proofs had come to them, they took the calf. Yet We pardoned this, and We gave Moses a clear authority.
4:154: And because of their covenant We raised the Mount over them and We said to them, 'Enter the gate prostrating,' and We said to them, 'Do not transgress on the Sabbath day,' and We took from them a firm pledge.
4:155: It is because of their breaking their covenant, their disbelieving in the verses of Allah, their killing the prophets unjustly, and their saying, 'Our hearts are covered.' Rather, Allah has sealed their hearts because of their disbelief, so they do not believe except a few.
4:156: And because of their disbelief and their uttering against Mary a great slander.
4:157: And it is because of their saying, 'We killed the Messiah, Jesus son of Mary, the messenger of Allah.' Yet they did not kill him and they did not crucify him, but it was made to appear (a likeness) to them. And indeed, those who differ concerning him are in a doubt about it. They have no knowledge of it, except following conjecture. They did not kill him for certain.
4:158: Rather, Allah raised him to Himself, and Allah is Mighty, Possessor of judgment and wisdom.
4:159: And there is none from the People of the Book but will surely believe in him before his death, and on the Day of Resurrection he will be a witness over them.
4:160: Because of the wrongdoing of the Jews, We made unlawful to them good things that were made lawful to them, and because of their hindering much from the way of Allah.
4:161: And because of their taking usury, while they had been forbidden from it, and because of their consuming people's wealth falsely.
4:162: But those firmly rooted in knowledge among them and the believers believe in what has been revealed to you and what was revealed before you; they establish the prayer, give zakat, and believe in Allah and the Last Day; to those We will give a great reward.
4:163: Indeed, We have revealed to you as We revealed to Noah and the prophets after him. And We revealed to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, the descendants, Jesus, Job, Jonah, Aaron, and Solomon. And to David We gave the Zabur.
4:164: And messengers whom We have narrated to you before and messengers whom We have not narrated to you; and Allah spoke to Moses with a speaking.
4:165: Messengers as bringers of good tidings and warners, so that people would have no argument against Allah after the messengers; and Allah is All-Mighty, Possessor of judgment and wisdom.
4:166: But Allah bears witness to what He has revealed to you. He revealed it with His knowledge. And the angels bear witness. And Allah is sufficient as a witness.
4:167: Indeed, those who disbelieved and hindered from the way of Allah have certainly strayed into a far error.
4:168: Indeed, those who disbelieved and wronged, Allah will not forgive them, nor will He show them a way,
4:169: Except the way to Hell, abiding therein forever. And that is easy for Allah.
4:170: O people, the messenger has come to you with the truth from your Rabb. Believe, it is better for you. And if you disbelieve, indeed, whatever is in the heavens and on the earth belongs to Allah. Allah is Knowing, Wise.
4:171: O People of the Book, do not exceed limits in your religion and do not say about Allah except the truth. The Messiah, Jesus son of Mary, is only the messenger of Allah and His word that He cast to Mary and a spirit from Him. So believe in Allah and His messengers and do not say 'Three.' Desist, it is better for you. Allah is only one God. He is exalted above having a child. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and on the earth. And Allah is sufficient as a Trustee.
4:172: The Messiah will never disdain to be a servant of Allah, nor will the angels brought near. And whoever disdains His worship and shows arrogance, He will gather them all to Himself.
4:173: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, He will give them their rewards in full and increase them from His bounty. And as for those who disdain and are arrogant, He will punish them with a painful punishment, and they will find for themselves besides Allah neither a protector nor a helper.
4:174: O people, a conclusive proof has come to you from your Rabb, and We have sent down to you a clear light.
4:175: As for those who believe in Allah and hold fast to Him, He will admit them into a mercy and bounty from Himself, and guide them to a path towards Himself.
4:176: They ask you for a ruling. Say: Allah gives you a ruling concerning kalalah. If a man perishes, and he has no child, and he has a sister, for her (the sister) is half of what he leaves. And he (the brother) inherits from her if she (the sister) has no child. If they are two (sisters), for the two of them is two-thirds of what he leaves. And if they (the siblings) are men and women, then for the male is the share of two females. Allah makes clear to you lest you go astray. And Allah is Knower of all things.
